name: Redigo Social Chat
author: Depakar B

sections.description:
Redigo Social Chat adds three lightweight floating elements to your site. Put the buttons in the same corner and they stack automatically, so they never overlap.

Chat button:
* Channels: WhatsApp (with prefilled message), phone, Telegram, email, SMS, Messenger, Viber, Signal and custom URL
* Bundled icons for every channel, plus Instagram, Facebook and X, or your own icon URL
* Text button or round icon-only button
* Colour pickers for button and text

Scroll to top:
* Show after a configurable scroll distance
* Square, rounded or circle shape, size from 36px to 64px
* Chevron, arrow or double chevron icon
* Optional progress ring that fills as the visitor scrolls
* Background, icon and ring colours
* Optional hide on mobile
* Smooth scrolling that respects the reduced motion preference
* Replaces a scroll-to-top button added by a supported theme, so only one shows

Reading progress bar:
* Separate from the scroll-to-top button
* Top or bottom of the screen, 2px to 12px high
* Bar colour, track colour and track opacity
* Optional hide on mobile
* Can hide a progress bar already added by your theme or a footer snippet
* Buttons move away from the bar automatically

Layout:
* Any corner for each button
* Stack order and gap when both buttons share a corner
* Separate desktop and mobile edge spacing

Settings page:
* Tabs for Chat Button, Scroll to Top, Progress Bar and Layout
* Live preview of everything as you edit

No external requests: all icons and scripts are bundled with the plugin.

For developers

Filters: redigo_social_chat_defaults, redigo_social_chat_sanitize, redigo_social_chat_render_settings, redigo_social_chat_chat_url, redigo_social_chat_chat_attributes, redigo_social_chat_dock_items, redigo_social_chat_frontend_config, redigo_social_chat_admin_tabs, redigo_social_chat_disable_theme_scrolltop, redigo_social_chat_theme_progress_selectors.

Actions: redigo_social_chat_loaded, redigo_social_chat_admin_tab_{id}, redigo_social_chat_admin_preview_after.

The admin preview fires a rsc:preview DOM event on document after each update.

Credits

Brand icons from the SVG Logos and Simple Icons collections (CC0). Phone, email and SMS icons from Material Design Icons (Apache License 2.0).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder redigo-social-chat to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Redigo Social Chat from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Redigo Social Chat in the admin menu and save your preferred settings.
sections.faq:
My theme already has a scroll-to-top button. Will I see two?

When the plugin’s scroll-to-top button is enabled, it removes a supported theme’s button. For other themes, turn off the theme’s button or disable the plugin’s scroll-to-top in the Scroll to Top tab.

My site already has a reading progress bar. Will I see two?

Keep “Replace Existing Bar” checked in the Progress Bar tab. It hides bars with the ID read-progress-wrap. Developers can add other selectors with the redigo_social_chat_theme_progress_selectors filter.

How do I show only the chat icon without text?

Leave the Button Text field empty. The button becomes a round icon.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: reading progress bar with position, height, colours and mobile options
  • New: optional progress ring on the scroll-to-top button
  • New: email, SMS, Messenger, Viber and Signal channels
  • New: all icons bundled locally, no external requests
  • New: more developer hooks for add-ons
  • Tweak: phone, email, SMS and Viber links no longer open a new tab

1.1.0

  • New: scroll-to-top button with position, threshold, shape, size, icon, colour and mobile options
  • New: corner docks so buttons in the same corner stack instead of overlapping
  • New: Layout tab with stack order, gap and separate mobile spacing
  • New: tabbed settings page with colour pickers and a live preview of both buttons
  • New: developer hooks for extending the plugin
  • Fix: chat button corner position was not applied

1.0.0

  • Initial release
